This is a rare opportunity to set the criticality safety strategy for a next-generation enrichment facility rather than inherit one — and to do it at a company where your technical decisions have a direct line to whether we get licensed and operating on schedule. We're especially looking for engineers who've done this before at an NRC-licensed Part 70 facility, or who bring deep DOE criticality safety experience and are ready to translate that rigor into the NRC licensing framework. If you've spent your career fitting criticality safety work into someone else's program and are ready to build the program instead, we encourage you to apply and lead this work at General Matter. Responsibilities Own the criticality safety program end-to-end: set methodology, double-contingency strategy, and technical direction for the site.
